from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,socket,sys,tarfile,time
p=Path('/home/dflanag3/src/spacial_desktop/spatial-os-luna-handoff');assert socket.gethostname().split('.')[0]=='sb16'
os.umask(0o077);sys.path[:0]=[str(p/'tests/core'),str(p/'build/python'),str(p)]
sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],str(p/'build/identityd')]
from test_identity_tls import TlsFixture
import issuer_pb2 as pb
fixture=TlsFixture();fixture.setUp()
folder=p/'local/m01-watch-crosshost';folder.mkdir()
try:
 fixture.config.idle_timeout_ms=10000
 proc=fixture.launch('0.0.0.0')
 peer=fixture.connect()
 change=fixture.execute(peer,fixture.challenge(peer,fixture.operation(pb.APPROVE_ALWAYS,profile='empty-v1')))
 assert change.policy.policy.mode==pb.APPROVE_ALWAYS
 enrolled=fixture.enroll(peer);claims=fixture.claims(enrolled,fixture.info);peer.close()
 metadata={'host':'sb16','port':fixture.port,'issuer_id':fixture.info.issuer_id.hex(),'issuer_public_key':fixture.info.public_key.hex(),'credential_id':claims.credential_id.hex()}
 meta=fixture.root/'connection.json';meta.write_text(json.dumps(metadata))
 bundle=folder/'fixture.tar'
 with tarfile.open(bundle,'w') as archive:
  for file in [meta,fixture.server_cert,fixture.service_cert,fixture.service_key]:archive.add(file,arcname=file.name,recursive=False)
 print('READY '+str(fixture.port),flush=True)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+180;revoked=False
 while not (folder/'stop').exists():
  assert proc.poll() is None
  if not revoked and (folder/'revoke').exists():
   peer=fixture.connect()
   operation=pb.IssuerOperation(identity_revoke=pb.IdentityRevoke(target=pb.IdentityReference(kind=pb.CREDENTIAL_TARGET,id=claims.credential_id),expected_security_revision=0,reason='cross-host fixture'))
   result=fixture.execute(peer,fixture.challenge(peer,operation))
   assert result.identity_status.credential_revoked and result.identity_status.security_revision==1
   revoked=True
  if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Cross-host fixture expired')
  time.sleep(.1)
 assert revoked
 peer.close()
 record={'server_host':'sb16','client_host':'sb16-2','protocol':'TLSv1.3','fixture_only':True,
         'identityd_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'build/identityd').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
         'test_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'tests/core/test_identity_watch.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 (folder/'server.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
finally:
 fixture.doCleanups()
 if (folder/'fixture.tar').exists():(folder/'fixture.tar').unlink()
fixture_cleanup: Temporary keys, certificates, issuer database, and transfer archives removed.

coordinator.transport: scp -3 relayed the disposable service bundle through the Windows SSH client with normal host verification.
coordinator.trigger: After WATCH_READY, the coordinator created the server revoke marker and the client release marker through their existing SSH connections.
setup_attempts: The first fixture was stopped before testing to reconnect its management peer only when revocation was requested.
The second setup transfer failed because sb16-2 did not trust the sb16 SSH host key. It was stopped before notification testing. The coordinator then used its existing verified SSH connections.
